change.summary: Harden the opt-in H4 persistent writer qualification marker and stale-root isolation; add a claim-before-target abort/reopen regression.
invariants: JSON marker bytes and rename are followed by mandatory parent-directory fsync; sync errors fail closed.
prepare refuses any non-empty root, preventing stale database or marker replay contamination.
A dispatch claim is durable before target invocation; abort in the claim-to-target window reopens Indeterminate.
An old queued receipt cannot redispatch after a durable claim; the target call count remains zero on retry.
Explicit recovery terminalizes as released_indeterminate with external_effect=false and physical_power_loss_claim=false.
No provider, production authority, physical power-loss, or root-owned seal claim is made.
implementation: validate_prepare_root rejects an existing marker and any non-empty qualification root before opening a store.
write_json_atomic fsyncs the parent directory after rename and propagates directory-sync errors.
ClaimThenBlockTarget models a crash after the durable claim and before target completion without invoking a provider effect.
The regression reopens a fresh writer, asserts Indeterminate, rejects the old receipt as StaleReceipt without redispatch, and performs explicit fail-closed local recovery.
